games.note: Two undefeated ACC teams on a Friday night in one of my favorite CFB environments in Blacksburg.
Mississippi State is 4-0 and already beat Missouri. Hosting Alabama at noon tells us whether that start is real.
Two Big 12 teams sitting just outside my poll. The winner is knocking on the door next week.
Iowa is 4-0 and jumped fifteen spots in my poll this week. The No. 2 team coming to Kinnick is the fastest way to find out if they earned it.
Both 3-1, both in the middle of my top 25. The loser slides into the pack that's one bad week from falling out.
Missouri just fell out of my top 25 after losing in Starkville. Beating an undefeated Florida puts them right back in.
Miami is 4-0 and Clemson is out of my top 25 at 3-1. Death Valley at night is still Death Valley.
